# Fixture Wiki Index

Navigation for the static WP07 contract fixture. This file is a reserved
OpenWiki basename (`index.md`), so it is intentionally excluded from the
searchable retrieval surface.

## Pages

- `architecture/retry-control.md` — retry/backoff/cancellation behavior.
- `operations/deployment.md` — release promotion and rollback.
